name: Star Health & Allied Insurance Company Ltd
about: Star Health & Allied Insurance Ltd (Star) is India’s first Standalone Health Insurance provider and is the largest private health insurer in India with a market share of 15.8% in the Indian health insurance market in FY21 with leadership in the attractive retail health segment.[1]
keyPoints: Market Share - H1FY26[1] Retail Health Insurance - 32% Gross Written Premium - Rs 8,332 Cr As on December 2024, it holds a 44% market share among standalone health insurers (SAHI) and 13% of the overall insurance market.[2]
cons: Stock is trading at 3.14 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 10.2% over last 3 years.
